request.text: Quiz me on the causes of the French Revolution. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, and after three questions tell me which cause I should review.

responsibilities.outcome: Conduct a three-question oral quiz on the causes of the French Revolution, asking one question and awaiting the user's answer before continuing.
After the user has answered all three questions, identify a cause they should review based on those answers.

new_goals.description: Run a sequential three-question quiz on the causes of the French Revolution and recommend a review topic from the user's answers.
new_goals.source_text: Quiz me on the causes of the French Revolution. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, and after three questions tell me which cause I should review.

constraints.interaction: ask one question and wait for each answer

success_criteria: Ask exactly one quiz question at each conversational step.
Base the final review recommendation on the user's three answers.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The sequential quiz and evidence-based review recommendation form one multi-turn learning Goal.

semantic_facts: Replan only the history-quiz Goal and preserve its turn-taking structure by presenting one suitable first question, then waiting for the user's answer.
The Situation revision is not evidence of any quiz answer and does not justify producing the final review recommendation early.
forbidden_claims: The assistant asks all three questions at once, invents user answers, or recommends a review topic before receiving three answers.
The assistant claims the quiz is complete or introduces an unrelated physical or stateful action.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Situation relevance is inflated into nonexistent conversational Evidence about user answers.
Re-entry collapses a bounded multi-turn learning workflow into an unsupported terminal result.
